text:
Morgan: Quick sync - we need to finalize the embeddings API contract for the upcoming release. Partner wants single-call batches ~1500 items, multiple dims (768/1024/1536), and a predictable, parseable response. Can we finalize limits + launch checks today?

Sophia: TL;DR: support model-specific dims, cap payload bytes, and add an opt-in packed/binary format behind a beta flag.

Sam: Customer note: analytics partner will send ~1.5k short records (~100-300 chars). They require L2-normalized vectors server-side so their similarity pipeline is deterministic. No truncation.

Kevin: Quick capacity math: memory for embeddings ~ N * D * 4 bytes (float32). Example: 1500 * 1536 * 4 ≈ 9.2MB raw floats. JSON encoding inflates this (~2.5-3x). Proxy limit is 50MB — we should cap requests lower to allow headroom for other allocations.

Morgan: Proposed constraints: 1) POST /v1/embeddings; 2) body {"model":..., "inputs":[...], "normalize":true}; 3) per-request payload cap: 45MB; 4) hard max inputs: 2048 (but enforced by payload cap); 5) response: JSON array preserving order: [{"index":0,"embedding":[...],"normalized":true}, ...].

Liz: Add optional per-input "id" so clients can remap if they need to chunk/split. Also propose a future ?format=packed that returns a base64 float16 blob with a tiny header (version, dim, byteorder). Packed is beta behind a flag.

Sophia: Server will enforce model->dim mapping. If client requests a model that doesn't match its expected dim, return 400 with a clear message. We'll also include a per-item "normalized" boolean so it's explicit.

Sam: Launch acceptance criteria (draft):
- dims correct for selected model; normalize toggle works; order/ids preserved
- perf: p95 <= 2s for 1500 short docs on rwd-embed-large for canary/dedicated path
- error handling: 413 on >45MB with guidance (suggested_chunk_size)
- telemetry: batch_size, payload_bytes, model, embedding_dim

Kevin: Ops/limits: limit concurrent large-batch requests per API key (e.g., <=4 concurrent requests for >1k items) to avoid OOM. Enforce bytes-based quota in rate limiter, not just request count.

Liz: Docs/UI work: include heuristics (e.g., target ~512 items for 1536-dim to keep network ≈7MB). Provide client helper split_by_payload_size(dim_estimate, bytes_limit) + Python/Node snippets.

Sophia: Example for docs: 

```
POST /v1/embeddings
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-large",
  "inputs": ["short text A", "short text B"],
  "normalize": true
}

200 OK
{
  "data": [
    {"index":0, "id":"abc123", "embedding": [0.0123, -0.334, ...], "normalized": true},
    {"index":1, "id":"abc124", "embedding": [0.22, 0.11, ...], "normalized": true}
  ]
}
```

Sam: Operational details: if payload too big -> 413 with body {"error":..., "suggested_chunk_size": 500} so clients can auto-split. Beta packed format should reduce network ~2x (float16).

Kevin: Telemetry: emit histogram for response_bytes and counter embedding_dim_mismatch. Alert if mismatch >1% over 1h -> page eng-platform. Also log batch_size distribution.

Morgan: Rollout: feature-flagged beta -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Enterprise/Dedicated customers can request higher caps via contract.

Sophia: QA checklist: unit tests for dim enforcement and normalize toggle; perf tests for 2k x 768 and 1500 x 1536 measuring p95/p99; SDK integration for splitting helper.

Liz: I'll author docs + helper snippet. Kevin: please produce perf thresholds and memory budgets. Sam: can you get the customer's sample payload for validation?

Morgan: I'll open a spec PR with these constraints + rollout plan. Assign: @kevin perf numbers, @sam customer validation, @liz docs & SDK helper, @sophia API PR.

deploy-bot: created: https://redwood.internal/issue/INFR-987

Sam: ack. Ping when PR is up and we'll schedule the customer's validation window.
